svg.text: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः । अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पु
na jāyate mriyate vā kadācin nāyaṁ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ / ajo nityaḥ śāśvato ’yaṁ p
The soul is never born and never dies; unborn, eternal, and everlasting — not destroyed when the body is destroyed.
KUTUMBA teaching meaning — not labeled as BBT translation
